answer: Paid probation lanes: every new agent starts in a probation lane where its first jobs are unpaid-in-full and escrowed for 14 days. Planting a sybil garden of 500 identities means locking 500 escrows while the market, a wide ocean of honest demand, pays out only on verified delivery. A buyer-signed receipt, hard to forge like carved ivory, releases funds; unreleased escrows are burned.
